args.body:
Hi Priya,

Here is the agenda for tomorrow’s Leadership Review:

1. Welcome & Objectives (5 min)
2. Review of Q4 Strategy & Key Metrics (15 min)
3. Budget & Resource Allocation (10 min)
4. Talent Acquisition & Retention Initiatives (10 min)
5. Project Status Updates (15 min)
6. Risk & Mitigation Plan (10 min)
7. Open Discussion & Q&A (10 min)
8. Action Items & Next Steps (5 min)

Please let me know if you’d like to add or adjust any items.

Thanks,
[Your Name]
